articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds from midterm dip as DeFi leads gains
articles.snippet: Bitcoin recovered from a dip to around $75,600 as Democrats won Congress, while DeFi tokens led gains and Trump-linked coins fell.

articles.title: Trump-linked tokens lead crypto losses after Democrats sweep in the US midterms
articles.snippet: The official Trump and World Liberty Financial tokens were the two biggest losers among the top 100 cryptocurrencies on Wednesday, even as Bitcoin and Ether rallied.

articles.title: Democrats win US House to secure control of Congress in midterms
articles.snippet: Democrats will take control of House committees in January 2027, giving them power to investigate President Donald Trump’s administration.

articles.title: Democrats claim control of the US Senate
articles.snippet: The shift in Senate control could change the path for the CLARITY Act, reshape committee leadership and bring closer scrutiny of Trump’s crypto businesses.

articles.title: Justin Sun Accuses Trump-Backed World Liberty of Using UAE Ties to Escape Federal Court
articles.snippet: Tron founder Justin Sun said he has asked a federal court to sanction World Liberty Financial, alleging the Trump family-backed venture delayed disclosing UAE ties that could defeat federal jurisdiction over his lawsuit.
